title: Account page
body: The account page is open to signed-in people only. A person who is not signed in is taken to sign in and then back to the account page. ^ACC-1
The page shows the person's avatar, name, email with a mark when the email is verified, roles and the date they joined. ^ACC-2

Email, password, two-factor authentication and passkeys are changed in the Logto Account Center, which the account page links to; after a change the person comes back to the account page and sees what changed: the email, the password, two-factor authentication or a passkey. ^ACC-3
